effects.target: top four cards of your library

provenance.text: Look at the top four cards of your library and separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. An opponent chooses one of the piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

proposed_edges.scope: top four cards of your library, sorted into two piles

proposed_edges.condition: an opponent chooses which pile goes to hand

provenance.text: Put that pile into your hand

proposed_edges.scope: the pile the opponent did not select
